sloka: इत्येवम् विविधा वाचो नानाजनसमीरिताः।शुश्राव रामः श्रुत्वा च न विचक्रे अस्य मानसम् ॥२-३३-२६॥
transliteration: ityevam vividhā vāco nānājanasamīritāḥ।śuśrāva rāmaḥ śrutvā ca na vicakre asya mānasam ॥2-33-26॥

translations.english: Such were the various words uttered by the people. Even after hearing them his (Rama's) mind remained unmoved (from his resolve).
